newsitem.title: USA: Small plane crashes near N.H. airport - police.
newsitem.headline: Small plane crashes near N.H. airport - police.

text.p: A small plane crashed on Wednesday on an interstate highway that runs parallel to one of the runways of Lebanon airport, near the New Hampshire-Vermont border, police said.
"We have reports of at least one injury," a Lebanon police officer, who declined to be identified, said. "At least one person was taken to the hospital."
The plane crashed onto Interstate 89 shortly after 12:30 p.m. EDT (1630 GMT).
"The highway runs parallel to one of the airport's runways. Looks like they picked the wrong piece of concrete to try and land on," the officer said.
Police and rescue officials were at the scene.
